UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and personal alert/audio preferences scoped strictly to the authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name for community discussion.

email.description: User email address (private PII, accessible only to the owner).

monitoredRegionIds.description: List of region IDs monitored by this user.

soundVolume.description: Voice alert playback volume from 0.0 to 1.0.

vibrationEnabled.description: Whether haptic vibration is enabled on alerts.

autoPlayVoice.description: Whether incoming real-time alerts play voice audio once automatically.

dsnsAutoSyncEnabled.description: Whether automatic sync with official Ukraine alerts API is enabled.

selectedTab.description: Last selected bottom navigation tab index (0..4).

selectedRegionId.description: Last selected region ID on map.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AlertRegion.title: AlertRegion
AlertRegion.description: Live alert state for a Ukrainian region or Kryvoozerska hromada managed by Administrator Denis.

regionName.description: Display name of the region or hromada.

activeLevels.description: All simultaneous active alert level names.

threatDetails.description: Human-readable threat description or all-clear notice.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who published the update.

isPublic.description: Marks document as readable by signed-in community members.

alertStartTime.description: Epoch milliseconds when current alert started, omitted when SAFE.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AlertEvent.title: AlertEvent
AlertEvent.description: Immutable real-time emergency broadcast or all-clear log event authored by Administrator Denis.

regionName.description: Target region or Ukraine-wide display name.

activeLevels.description: List of alert levels triggered in this event.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

isBroadcastBanner.description: Whether this event updates the live top broadcast banner.

isTotalAllClear.description: Whether this event is a Ukraine-wide total all-clear.

isPublic.description: Marks event readable by signed-in community members.

clientTimestampMs.description: Client event timestamp in epoch milliseconds for sorting.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CommunityMessage.title: CommunityMessage
CommunityMessage.description: Real-time community discussion message visible to signed-in users.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

isAdminVerified.description: True only when authored by verified administrator.

isPublic.description: Marks message readable by signed-in community members.

clientTimestampMs.description: Client creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Private user settings, monitored region list, and UI preferences isolated by userId.

/alert_regions/{regionId}.description: Live emergency alert states per region/hromada broadcast by Administrator Denis.

/alert_events/{eventId}.description: Immutable emergency alert & all-clear event log broadcast by Administrator Denis.

/community_messages/{messageId}.description: Live community discussion chat synchronized across signed-in devices.
